questions.stem: What does Conceptual Data Modelling (CDM) provide?
options: A high-level, business-oriented view of data identifying core entities and their relationships without technical implementation details
A platform-specific storage design with indexes
questions.explanation: CDM describes how the business views its data, not how the database stores it, focusing on entities and relationships.

questions.stem: What is the primary goal of Conceptual Data Modelling?
options: To capture the essence of business information in a way non-technical stakeholders can understand and validate
To define data types for every column
questions.explanation: CDM captures business information so leaders, analysts and architects can agree on what exists and how it relates before detailed design.

questions.stem: Which of the following is intentionally omitted at the conceptual modelling level?
options: Entities such as Customer and Loan
Attributes such as interest rate, date fields and data types
questions.explanation: Attributes such as interest rate, date fields or data types are intentionally omitted; the focus is on what exists and how it connects.

questions.stem: In the loan domain, what cardinality describes the relationship between Customer and Loan?
options: One-to-zero-or-many, since each Loan has exactly one Customer but a Customer may have zero, one or many Loans
questions.explanation: Each Loan must be linked to exactly one Customer, while a Customer may have zero, one or many Loans: a one-to-zero-or-many relationship.

questions.stem: Why is the relationship between Loan and Approval Decision described as one-to-zero-or-one?
options: Because a loan can have many decisions
Because a Loan may not yet have a decision while under review, but once processed has exactly one
Because approval is stored in a separate system
questions.explanation: A Loan still under review has no decision yet; once processed it has exactly one, such as approved or rejected.

questions.stem: What cardinality holds between an approved Loan and its Repayment Schedule?
questions.explanation: Every approved Loan must have exactly one Repayment Schedule and each Repayment Schedule belongs to exactly one Loan: a one-to-one relationship.

questions.stem: In the university example, how is the Student and Course relationship represented at the conceptual level?
options: As a many-to-many relationship, resolved into junction entities later in logical or physical modelling
questions.explanation: A Student can enrol in multiple Courses and a Course can have multiple Students; this many-to-many is resolved into associative entities later.

questions.stem: What transition does Conceptual Data Modelling mark?
options: From process thinking to structural thinking
questions.explanation: Where process models describe how work flows, conceptual models describe what exists and how elements relate: the shift from process to structural thinking.

questions.stem: Which statement about Logical Data Modelling (LDM) is correct?
options: It is a single modelling technique
It is a stage in the modelling journey where different modelling families and design philosophies emerge
It only applies to OLAP systems
questions.explanation: LDM is not a single technique but a stage where structural rules, normalisation, constraints and integrity are formally defined.

questions.stem: In the overview of logical modelling families, which technique has the stated limitation of being complex for business users despite offering full traceability?
questions.explanation: Data Vault provides historical tracking, auditability and full traceability, but its limitation is that it is complex for business users.
